## Description
Briefly explain the intent, scope, and implementation details of this change.

## Artifact Lineage (LLM Wiki Traceability)
- **Upstream Intent Brief:** [`IB-###`](docs/project-plan/intents/)
- **UI/UX Design Spec:** [`UI-###`](docs/architecture/ui/) *(if user-facing)*
- **Requirements & Spec:** [`PRD-###`](docs/project-plan/specs/)
- **Architecture Decision:** [`ADR-###`](docs/architecture/adrs/) *(if architectural change)*
- **Task Reference:** [`TASK-###`](docs/project-plan/tasks/)

## Type of Change
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] UI/UX refinement (design tokens, component polish, accessibility)
- [ ] Architectural change / ADR
- [ ] Documentation / Spec update

## Quality & Verification Checklist
- [ ] **Unit Tests:** All unit tests pass locally and coverage is maintained.
- [ ] **Component Tests:** Interactive component rendering and states verified.
- [ ] **Integration & E2E Tests:** End-to-end flows and API contracts verified.
- [ ] **Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA):** Color contrast, keyboard focus, and screen-reader labels checked.
- [ ] **Security & Privacy:** No secrets/credentials committed; student PII protected (FERPA/COPPA compliant).
- [ ] **LLM Wiki Registration:** Newly added or modified artifacts are registered in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md).
